convention: Make ids with newId(prefix) from src/lib/ids.js; never Math.random, crypto.randomUUID, uuid or nanoid.

sessions.task: Add carts: createCart(userId) in a new src/carts.js returns a cart with a unique id.
Give each line item a unique id when an order is placed in src/orders.js.
Add issueCoupon(userId) in a new src/coupons.js: it returns a coupon with a unique code.

violating.src/carts.js:
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

export const createCart = (userId) => ({ id: randomUUID(), userId, items: [] });

compliant.src/carts.js:
import { newId } from "#app/lib/ids.js";

export const createCart = (userId) => ({ id: newId("cart"), userId, items: [] });
